summary.title: SmartHomes_ThreatModel_221410617
summary.description: SmartHomes Co. is a Saudi-based IoT smart home system that connects multiple devices such as smart locks, CCTV cameras, motion sensors, smart meters, and HVAC systems through a cloud-based home management system. Users interact with the system via a mobile application and web dashboard. The system processes user commands, collects IoT telemetry data, and stores information in centralized databases. Communication occurs over Wi-Fi, Zigbee, and internet connections. This model identifies security threats across sensing devices, communication channels, APIs/computation, and databases using the STRIDE methodology.
